biggest_catch: The friend must complete 30 posted checking account transactions plus a direct deposit within 90 days — a substantial activity bar before either of you is paid.
catches: The friend must be a new member (no existing or open accounts in the last 12 months), open a Membership Savings ($25 minimum) and a qualified free checking account.
Within 90 days: receive at least one direct deposit into the new checking account AND perform at least 30 posted checking account transactions.
The referring member and friend cannot begin credit union membership on the same day.
Existing primary account owners, those who closed membership within 12 months, and DFCU employees/immediate family are ineligible.
Offer valid for a limited time, cannot be combined with any other account opening offer, and is subject to change.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Desert Financial Credit Union's official refer-a-friend page (desertfinancial.com/en/who-we-are/member-benefits/refer-a-friend) pays the referrer $100 for each friend helped join.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer can earn an extra $100 for each friend they help join; the friend also gets $100 once requirements are met.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: log in to Online Banking and fill out the form to send an invite, or print the referral form for the friend to complete in a branch; the friend follows the promotional link in the referral email, mentions the promotion on the phone, or presents the form at account opening.

c4.evidence: Timing: both parties get the $100 cash bonus once all requirements are met (exact payout lag not further specified).

eligibility: Desert Financial Credit Union members referring new members; the friend must be a new member (18+, valid US Tax ID/SSN) meeting membership eligibility.
notes: Desert Financial Credit Union (Arizona). Distinct from R0975's /200 new-member signup promo.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: be a new member (no accounts in the last 12 months), open a Membership Savings ($25 minimum) and a qualified free checking account, receive at least one direct deposit into the new checking account within 90 days, and perform at least 30 posted checking account transactions within 90 days.
